ИИ отвечает медленно (%.0f ток/с): модел: The AI is answering slowly (%.0f tok/s): the model didn't fit into video memory - only %d%% is on the video card, the rest is in regular memory. Other programs took the video memory: a stream or a Discord call, a browser, a video player, games. In Discord turn off hardware acceleration (Settings - Advanced), close what you don't need and restart DeskSaw - the model will load again. Or pick a smaller model in model_manager (qwen3-vl:8b-instruct fits in 8 GB).
ИИ отвечает медленно (%.0f ток/с). Ollam: The AI is answering slowly (%.0f tok/s). Ollama thinks the whole model is in video memory, but most likely the video memory is maxed out and the driver quietly moved part of it to regular memory. Check: Task Manager - Performance - GPU - "Shared GPU memory": if it's above 0.3 GB, there isn't enough video memory. It helps to close or minimize what's holding the video card (browser, player, a second stream), turn off hardware acceleration in Discord and restart DeskSaw. Or pick a smaller model in model_manager.
ИИ отвечает медленно (%.0f ток/с). Если: The AI is answering slowly (%.0f tok/s). If there's a stream or a Discord call - turn off hardware acceleration in it (Settings - Advanced) and close extra programs that use the video card.
